An aggregation service name must contain the Aggregation identifier.

What the Standard says

“Aggregation Services” — An aggregation service provides one abstract point of contact over several related business services. Its name should identify that aggregation role so consumers understand the boundary they are calling. read it here.

Why it matters

The Aggregation suffix tells readers that the service combines variations of one capability rather than coordinating different business operations. Naming the layer explicitly makes its dependency and responsibility rules apparent before opening the file.

Bad code example

// Violates STXA002: An aggregation service name must contain the Aggregation identifier.
class StudentService(IStudentService students) : IStudentService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXA002
class StudentAggregationService(IStudentService students) : IStudentAggregationService { }
